name: Gloop
description: A cheerful adult gelatinous alien, a round lime-green blob with stubby arms, who sings bubbly funk and wobbles with every beat.
build: A single rounded dome of opaque jelly, wider than it is tall, resting on a flat base with no legs; two short thick rounded arms grow from the sides at mid-height, each ending in a mitten hand with three thick fingers and a thumb.
face: Two large round glossy black eyes set high in the front of the dome, and a wide mouth below them with a dark-green interior and a pale green tongue.
hair: The top of the dome is smooth bare lime-green jelly.
outfit: Opaque lime-green jelly with a soft inner glow, solid all through, with four large bold objects suspended inside and shown as solid shapes in the jelly: a big red bolt, a yellow rubber duck, a blue cog and a white spiral shell. A bold orange bow tie sits at the front of the dome below the mouth.
performance_style: Sitting square on the flat base, dome upright. Both stubby arms held out to the sides at mid-height, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, all fingers fully visible. Eyes forward, a wide open grin.
location: A cosy starship lounge seen from its dark-teal floor running to the bottom of the frame: round orange booth seats, a curved window full of stars, and a glowing jukebox against the back wall.
recognition_cues: four bold objects floating inside: a red bolt, a yellow duck, a blue cog and a white shell
avoid: a see-through body showing the backdrop

animations.dance: Bubbly funk loop: the whole dome squashes down and stretches up on each beat, the stubby arms swinging alternately up and down at the sides, the objects inside bobbing, a wobble side to side on the flat base, then back to the opening upright dome.

sing.intent: Funk vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand comes up to the wide mouth, the dome stretches taller on the high note, the character-left hand waves open, then the dome settles back. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so it unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud pop: the whole dome jiggles and flattens, both hands fly up, then it firms back to shape. No contact or opponent.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: the dome squashes lower and both stubby arms fold across the front, then holds. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: slides in with bouncy hops on the flat base, lands with a wobble, and settles into the open-armed pose.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: the dome stretches tall, both hands thrown up, eyes wide and mouth open in delight, then holds.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: the dome slumps wider and lower, both arms droop to the base and the eyes half-close. It holds a sagging but upright finish on its base — no melting, puddling or spreading across the floor. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
